title: Roof comparison for the fixed local relative tensor complex
statement: Let f:X→S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], E an object of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], G and K complexes, and eK:QK≅E tensor-derived QG [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let U be open and L strictly perfect on its localized open site [def-pc-perfect-complex], with eL:E|_U≅QL. There exist a complex H of (f inverse-image O_S)|_U-modules and quasi-isomorphisms H→(K restricted along f inverse-image O_S→O_X)|_U and H→T, where T is the fixed explicit relative tensor complex [def-pc-strict-perfect-relative-tensor-complex]. No relative-flatness condition on G, prescribed degree interval or K-flatness of T over the base is required or concluded.

proof.text: Use strictPerfect_relativeTensor_roof_comparison to obtain the isomorphism of the two fixed base-ring complexes in the standard derived category. This isolates the local tensor calculation from the chain-map roof construction.

Mathlib DerivedCategory.right_fac factors the derived isomorphism e.hom as inv(Q.map s) ≫ Q.map t, with Q.map s invertible. Multiply by Q.map s to obtain Q.map t = Q.map s ≫ e.hom, which is invertible. DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff_quasiIso gives QuasiIso s and QuasiIso t. Return the actual complex H and both actual chain maps. This is the fully proved private helper common_quasiIso_roof; it makes no choice of data in a definition.
